name: GandCrab
description: GandCrab was a Russian ransomware-as-a-service operation active January 2018 to May 2019, earning over $2 billion in extortion payments and at its peak accounting for up to half the global ransomware market. The group shipped five major code revisions and infected over 425,000 victims in a single month at peak volume. GandCrab 'retired' in May 2019, with leadership later identified as Daniil Shchukin ('UNKN') who immediately relaunched under the REvil name.

sources.title: Who's Behind the GandCrab Ransomware? — Krebs on Security
